notes: Illustrative manifest. Copy this directory to `goldens/<version>/`, build pi-harness.js into it, recompute sha256, register in pi.golden_images, then run scripts/apply-golden.ts. See ../README.md.

fs_setup.comment: Sprite images ship /home/sprite as 750; bumping to 755 lets the sprite user traverse into ~/.gccli etc., otherwise connectors silently fail on EACCES during existsSync.
